slides.h1: The Chart Behind Every 'Late Bloomer' Founder Story
slides.sub: You've heard this arc a dozen times: quiet decade, then a breakout nobody saw coming. There's usually a repeating pattern behind it.

slides.h2: The yoga: Raja Yoga, precisely defined
slides.body: A kendra lord (1st/4th/7th/10th house ruler) and a trikona lord (1st/5th/9th) connect — by conjunction, mutual aspect, or exchange. Not vague 'good luck' — a specific structural link.

slides.h2: Why it doesn't fire on day one
slides.body: The yoga exists in the birth chart from day one. It activates only when its own Mahadasha or Antardasha arrives — which is why the breakout looks sudden from the outside.
The Dashamsha (D-10, the career divisional chart) usually shows the same lords well-placed again — a second, independent signal pointing the same direction.
This isn't reserved for famous charts. A scaled-down version of the same Raja Yoga pattern shows up in ordinary charts constantly — most people never get it pointed out.
A free chart read tells you if you're sitting on one of these — and roughly when it activates.
